errors.text_span: The provided image does not contain a scientific column chart to describe.
errors.evidence: The image clearly contains a bar chart (柱状图) with a line overlay, contradicting the claim that no such chart exists.
The description fails to mention the chart's purpose: showing daily global COVID-19 case counts and media report trends from 2022-07-01 to 2022-08-26.
The description omits the x-axis label (日期) and its time range, as well as both y-axes labels (每日新增确诊人数 and 相关新闻媒体每日报道数量) and their ranges.
The description does not mention the left y-axis range (0–1,800,000) or step size (200,000).
The description does not mention the right y-axis range (0–6,000) or step size (1,000).
The description omits the color of the bars (蓝绿色) representing daily global confirmed cases.
The description omits the color of the line (蓝色) representing COVID-19-related news reports.
The description fails to mention the synchronized fluctuation trend between cases and media reports.
The description omits the existence of differential peak periods, such as delayed media reporting after case surges.
